$comment: Completion bar for #22: the YouTube URL field was passed to yt-dlp as a bare positional argument (no `--`) and host checks used `includes('youtube.com')` (matching evil-youtube.com), so input like `--exec=<cmd>` was parsed as an option and run as a command. Fix: parse with URL, allowlist YouTube hosts exactly, validate the video id (^[\w-]{11}$), and pass `--` before the URL in every yt-dlp invocation. Criteria 1-2 fail before the change (normalizeYoutubeUrl did not exist; the loose `includes('youtube.com')` host check was present); 3 covers the URL-validation + `--` unit tests; 4-6 guard typecheck, build, and the rest of the suite.
